name: essentials
description: Trustworks Essentials Java/Kotlin framework support. A slice-design law for vertical slices (command, view, automation, translation; the R1-R5 anti-god-class rules) with commands to scaffold, audit, discover and map slices; an application stack contract (S1-S11) with Kotlin/Java bindings, a React/TypeScript frontend spec and version pins; skills for the framework docs and change routing; and /essentials:init and /essentials:upgrade to create a verified project and keep it current.
